verdict: Spend is producing sales but lead volume collapsed this period, with cost per lead far above category norms.
diagnosis: Only 2 leads and 9 purchases from $4,655 spend this period. Return on ad spend sits at 1.27x — barely above breakeven.

signals.headline: Only 2 leads from $4,655 spend
signals.detail: Cost per lead landed near $2,328 this period. Category benchmarks for wellness sit around $98.

signals.headline: 9 purchases worth $5,897 revenue
signals.detail: Return on ad spend is 1.27x. Sales are happening, but margin after ad cost is thin.

signals.headline: 138 landing page views, 22 add-to-carts
signals.detail: Roughly 16% of visitors add to cart. Checkout drop-off is the biggest leak, not traffic quality.

signals.headline: 127 direction requests, 1 call
signals.detail: Google Business Profile drove strong map interest but almost zero phone calls. Phone path looks broken or hidden.

signals.headline: 2,093 clicks at $2.68 average
signals.detail: Click cost is reasonable for medical search. Traffic is arriving — conversion is where the funnel stalls.

recommendations.title: Fix the checkout drop between cart and purchase
recommendations.detail: 22 add-to-carts produced only 9 purchases. Consider testing guest checkout, clearer shipping cost, and a trust badge near the payment button.

recommendations.title: Rethink the "life alert" keyword bid
recommendations.detail: Bidding on a competitor's brand name is expensive and low-intent. Worth exploring product-category terms like "medical alert watch" or "fall detection wearable" instead.

recommendations.title: Add a click-to-call button on mobile landing page
recommendations.detail: 127 people asked for directions but only 1 called. A prominent phone number on the mobile ad landing page could capture warm buyers faster.
